content:
EXECUTE OPTION A IMMEDIATELY.

Do not stop at planning or status reporting.

Complete Option A end-to-end and verify every step with evidence.

Requirements:

1. Analyze the current implementation and identify every remaining blocker.
2. Implement all required code changes.
3. Run all builds, linting, type checking, and automated tests.
4. Fix every failure until all required checks pass.
5. Deploy the updated version using the approved deployment process.
6. Verify production health after deployment.
7. Confirm the deployed commit matches the GitHub HEAD commit.
8. Perform an end-to-end QA of all affected functionality.
9. Document every file changed, every test executed, and every deployment completed.
10. Produce a final verification report containing:
   - Git commit SHA
   - Deployment identifier
   - Build version
   - Test summary
   - Production health status
   - Remaining blockers (if any)
   - Exact evidence for every completed item

Do not mark any item as complete without verifiable evidence. If a blocker prevents completion, identify the exact root cause, the affected component, and the next required action.
